sentences.text: Sinanas is a genus of prehistoric duck.
It belongs to the family Anatidae, which includes modern ducks, geese, and swans.
This ancient bird lived between 20.45 and 15.98 million years ago.
Its fossils were discovered in the Shandong Province of China.
The genus was named by Yeh in 1980.
The only known species within the group is Sinanas diatomas.
Fossils of Sinanas date to the Miocene epoch.
This duck lived during the middle Miocene.
It is debated whether Sinanas is closely related to modern waterfowl.
